scope: Source dispositions for computed loader/binding sites plus lazy forwarding; not implementation, activation or full contract audit

records.reason: The const selector is child or primary based on actual NODE_UNIQUE_ID membership; neither branch is excluded.
Reporter name selects a value from the literal SafeMap; missing names go to the separate user ESM loader route.
Runtime-deprecated process.binding fallback is guarded by a source SafeSet, currently empty. Retain the site and empty source domain; this says nothing about backend implementation.
Original process.binding allow-list branch. Legacy natives/util wrappers take a separate JS route; the allow-list is not the complete native registry.
Embedder-added linked bindings are an open native domain; do not invent sources or handles.
Shared original internalBinding dispatches an actual requested native registry name. Literal consumer inventory cannot close all possible registered names.

Generic dependency loader strips node: or prefixes internal/deps for a missing ID, then dispatches through the shared BuiltinModule registry. Do not expand this to an unconditional edge to every source.
The normalized built-in ID is required after validation. supportedModules only controls a warning; it does not filter unsupported modules out of the graph.
Internal custom-loader registration uses a caller-supplied specifier; the noninternal branch uses the cascaded ESM loader. Keep both domains and the source isInternal condition.
getBuiltinModule validates the input and normalizes it through BuiltinModule policy; it is a generic public built-in dispatch entrypoint.
Reporter SafeMap values include a later conditional v8-serializer .set; collect all literal writes, not just initial entries.
Testing wrapper rejects internal_only prefix then forwards the remaining caller-supplied name. It does not mean every forwarded binding exists.

Accessor receives its module ID from defineReplaceableLazyAttribute registration; explicit helper registration sites are indexed independently. Constructor/alias/dataflow coverage is not inferred from callee names.

Receiver deserializer splits module:Constructor then requires the module and validates constructor/deserialization hook. Known producer metadata is indexed separately; native/user supplied producers keep this domain open.
exposeLazyInterfaces forwards its module argument to the native lazy-property helper. Concrete registrations are retained with source guards.
